security__policies_and_standards__password-standard.md:57:- Systems should monitor and log failed login attempts.
security__policies_and_standards__password-standard.md:58:- Information related to authentication failed login attempts need to be recorded within the application logs if technically feasible; such as: name, date, number of failed attempts, unique log identifier.
security__policies_and_standards__password-standard.md:59:- Repeated failed login attempts need to trigger a temporary account lockout after 10 failed attempts. If the particular system will not support lockout after 10 attempts or less, the lockout needs to be configured to the minimum value allowed by the system. The lockout may end after a designated period of time, or require a manual unlock, depending on the profile of the application.
